CAT's sales and revenues increased 18% in 2017, driven by higher sales volume and favorable changes in dealer inventories.

GS's net revenues in interest rate products were higher, reflecting higher client activity levels, compared to no comparable figure for JPM

PG's gross margin decreased 50 basis points to 50.4% in 2017, while NEE's gross margin increased 13% YoY.
